about_the_game:
About the Game

Digitalink is a psychological horror experience where every decision you make brings you closer to unlocking—or unleashing—a terrifying mind.

Trapped in a high-security research facility, you're tasked with mapping the neural responses of a massive, unidentified creature. You’ll analyze its behavior through cryptic logic puzzles, decipher twisted commands, and respond under pressure. Each correct decision reveals another fragment of its brain map... each mistake pushes it closer to aggression.

As tension builds, the creature reacts. Jump scares are not just for shock—they're consequences. The more you understand, the deeper the horror gets.

Key Features:

  • 🧠 Logic-Driven Gameplay: Solve layered logic puzzles under psychological pressure.

  • 👁️‍🗨️ Reactive Horror: The creature responds dynamically to your actions.

  • 🧬 Narrative Unfolding in Real-Time: Discover logs, warnings, and patterns hidden in the interface.

  • 💡 Minimalist Interface, Maximum Dread: The fear comes from what you don't see.

  • 🔁 Replayability: Every session can uncover new fragments of the creature’s mind.

You're not fighting the monster—you're studying it. But how long can you observe something... before it starts observing you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad CPU Q6600 @ 2.40GHz (4 CPUs) / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor (4 CPUs) @ 2.5GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 9800 GT 1GB / AMD HD 4870 1GB (DX 10, 10.1, 11)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3470 @ 3.2GHz (4 CPUs) / AMD X8 FX-8350 @ 4GHz (8 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB

short_description: Uncover the mind of a terrifying creature—one decision at a time. Digitalink blends psychological horror with logic-based gameplay in a uniquely unsettling experience filled with suspense, surprises, and scares.
